notes.title: Welcome to Starfighter X!
notes.notes:
Hello friends - we are pleased to open the Steam Store page for our title Starfighter X.

We are making the final technical tweaks to the game engine and content before our planned release on Nov. 1, 2018, in Early Access on Steam.

Over the next several months, we will expand and enhance the game in a variety of ways, as detailed in the Roadmap in the About section of our store page. 

Certainly the Roadmap will change over time as we gather feedback from our players, but this should give you an idea of the path the game is on. 

Please enjoy our updates and we are eager to see you online soon competing on the Leaderboards for the top spot in Starfighter X!
